errors.evidence: The phrase 'whole number ratio' is confusing and inaccurate as the labels are fractions. A clearer phrasing would be 'at intervals of 1/4'.
The markers on the MoHD line are squares, not triangles.
The MoHD line starts at a value of approximately 11.1 on the y-axis, not 10.9.
At 1/4 on the x-axis, the value for the MoHD line is approximately 10.6, not 10.4.
At 2/4 on the x-axis, the value for the MoHD line is exactly 10.5, not 10.2.
At 3/4 on the x-axis, the MoHD line reaches its minimum value of approximately 10.25, not 10.6. The description also incorrectly states the line is increasing to this point when it is decreasing.
The dashed line for the Transformer model is red, not orange.

The dashed line for the Transformer model is horizontal and constant at a value of approximately 11.6 across the entire x-axis. Stating that it finishes at 11.5 implies a downward slope that does not exist.
The description fails to mention the legend in the top right corner, which is crucial for identifying which line corresponds to which model.
The description omits the light blue shaded area between the two lines, which is a prominent visual feature highlighting the performance difference.
